packageVersionPolicy: Implementation uses the exact then-current Program Kit package version and exact package digests. Floating ranges, latest selectors, and build-output identities are forbidden.

rows.compatibilityBoundary: operation identity/revision, application contracts, authority/effect facts, compatibility and migration
rows.changeRule: changed catalog bytes require re-projection; incompatible operation change uses a new operation revision

rows.compatibilityBoundary: exact binding of Console or OpenAPI syntax to an operation revision
rows.changeRule: syntax changes do not change semantic identity unless the application owner changes the operation revision

rows.compatibilityBoundary: full/selected operation projection and transitive schema closure
rows.changeRule: compatible additions require regenerated host bytes; incompatible shape requires a reviewed migration

rows.compatibilityBoundary: normalized operation projection, selected invocation adapter, MCP tool mapping, registration proposal and lock
rows.changeRule: changed operation, tool, bridge, provider, or lock bytes require an explicit registration update

rows.compatibilityBoundary: bundle descriptor, capability catalog, procedure, operation bindings, knowledge closure, provider adapters, compatibility and migrations
rows.changeRule: changed authoritative bundle version or digest requires explicit capability update

rows.compatibilityBoundary: one deterministic flat catalog derived from accepted per-bundle/provider locks
rows.changeRule: same-bundle projection drift is repaired by explicit refresh; changed authoritative bundle bytes are never accepted by refresh

rows.owner: Application publisher plus Program Kit conformance
rows.compatibilityBoundary: publisher-official outcome semantics remain distinct from Program Kit integrity and completeness checks
rows.changeRule: publisher changes version and content identity; Program Kit never infers domain-semantic compatibility

rows.compatibilityBoundary: dual-era stdio bridge and exact invocation adapter behavior
rows.changeRule: exact nupkg and executable digests are registration inputs

rows.compatibilityBoundary: server/discover, per-request metadata, tools/list, tools/call, schemas/results, and stateless stdio behavior
rows.changeRule: selected modern revision; material drift stops implementation or update

rows.compatibilityBoundary: legacy initialize, tools/list, tools/call, object-root schemas/results, and stdio behavior
rows.changeRule: supported legacy era; removal requires separate compatibility review

rows.compatibilityBoundary: owned .codex/config.toml MCP entry and owned project skill projections
rows.changeRule: provider contract is rechecked at proposal time; material drift blocks

rows.compatibilityBoundary: owned .mcp.json entry, owned project skills, and separate observed trust/approval/permission
rows.changeRule: provider contract is rechecked at proposal time; material drift blocks

migrationPolicy: Tool registration and capability initialization have separate locks, proposals, and update transitions.
Compatible operation additions never silently enter an existing registration.
Compatible capability additions never silently enter an initialized workspace projection.
Refresh may regenerate catalog and provider adapters only from the same verified bundle and valid lock.
Update accepts a new exact bundle identity/digest after an explicit proposal.
An incompatible contract, schema, protocol, package, provider, operation, or capability change requires a reviewed migration or exact removal and fresh initialization.
No automatic source resolution, upgrade, permission mutation, provider start, or invocation is permitted.
